title: Disability Compensation Replacements: Additions for Minor Children and School Children
content:
The child additions in a replacement of a returned Disability Compensation payment are set by the children the award records:

| Minor children recorded | School children recorded | Child additions in the replacement |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | One or more | One child addition for each recorded minor child plus one school-child addition for each recorded school child |
| One or more | None | One child addition for each recorded minor child |
| None | One or more | One school-child addition for each recorded school child |
| None | None | Nothing |

**Counting.** The minor children recorded are the child additions on the award less the child removals; the school children recorded are the school-child additions on the award less the school-child removals. Every month a replacement covers counts the children so recorded.

**Rates.** The child addition and the school-child addition are taken from the 100 percent tier — 146.10 for each minor child and 472.95 for each school child — when the award's decision history shows individual unemployability granted, and from the award's own tier otherwise.

**Illustrations (hypothetical awards, no individual unemployability)**

- Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating), two minor children and one school child recorded: 58.44 multiplied by 2, plus 189.18, that is 306.06.
- Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating), one school child recorded, no minor child: 189.18.
- Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating), a child added and later removed, nothing else: no child is recorded, so nothing is added.
